scenario: Create and read back a REST API
steps: Create REST API via control plane; GET /rest-apis/{id}
expected_result: 201; read-back matches name, context, version, operations
API created; operations match the document

scenario: Import OpenAPI from an uploaded file
expected_result: API created with the document's operations

scenario: Invalid OpenAPI is rejected with validation errors
expected_result: 400 with readable errors; no API created

scenario: OpenAPI URL fetch is limited to allowed destinations and size
steps: Import from a link-local metadata address; import from an oversized document
expected_result: Both refused with 4xx; no outbound call to the metadata address

scenario: Updating the OpenAPI and redeploying changes what the gateway serves
steps: PUT /rest-apis/{id}/openapi adding /b and removing /a; deploy again
expected_result: Gateway answers /b with 200 and /a with 404 after propagation

scenario: Two versions of the same API are deployed and invoked side by side
steps: Create v2 with same context; GET /rest-apis/versions; deploy v2
expected_result: Versions endpoint lists both; /ctx/v1 and /ctx/v2 both 200 with their own backends

scenario: Duplicate context and version is a conflict
API handle is immutable and unknown plan handles are refused
steps: PUT with a different id; create with a plan handle that does not exist

scenario: Deleting a deployed API removes it from every gateway
expected_result: Both gateways return 404 for the route after propagation; API gone from list

scenario: Deleting an API that is published to an API Portal follows the documented contract
expected_result: Either refused with a clear reason, or the portal listing is removed too; never an orphaned portal listing
notes: Confirm intended contract with product owner before writing
